title: pomodoro slasher
tagline: Changing the way we get to focus. be at risk not able to sell at ATH, and having everything locked.
description:
Stake your tokens and commit to completing your tasks within Pomodoro sessions.
Complete all tasks? Get your stake back. Fail? Your tokens get locked until Christmas! 🎄
There is nothing better than being at risk of locking tokens during a bull run, or just take your fiat away from paying rent next month.
how_its_made:
I used Next.js, Privy for social login, and Biconomy as an AA infra.
I had an amazing time delving again into building apps one step closer to consumers.
Using fiat onramping privy but did not work so I added a second fiat onramping, the demo shows completely no metamask in favor of reaching my target audience with my dapps, my mom.
